props.title: Every session starts from ==zero.==
props.body: The same hard-won workflows, conventions, and lessons get re-explained, re-derived — or lost between conversations.

name: release-checklist
description: Ship a release without missing a step

# Release checklist

1. Run the full test suite
2. Update the changelog
3. Tag the commit
4. Announce it

## Evals
- Agent ships a tagged release with changelog intact

slides.notes: One self-contained file: instructions, examples, evals. The agent loads it when a task matches — expertise compounds instead of evaporating.

slides.notes: A loop, not a one-shot: every run makes the skill sharper for the next one.
